name: FTP test 20 min
description: Allen and Coggan's 20-minute test: 45 min warm-up with a 5-minute all-out effort, then 20 minutes all out. Both efforts run by resistance: set the load with + and −. Your FTP is 95 % of the 20-minute lap's average power.
protocol_source: Allen and Coggan, Training and Racing with a Power Meter, protocol table as replicated in PMC6886609, Table 1 (ICD RD-18): 20 min at 65 %, 3 × 1 min fast pedaling, 5 min at 65 %, 5 min all out, 10 min at 65 %, 20 min all out, 10–15 min at 65 %; FTP = 95 % of the 20-minute average

steps.text: 5 min all out: set the load with + and −
